note: Multiplier on a STARTER's projection (depth rank 1 on the published chart, as the build reads it), fitted on the live pipeline replayed over 2025 weeks 2-18 and checked on 2026 weeks 2-6 (research/depth_live.py). Boards: recn = receptions, rush / rr = yards.
td_note: Anytime TD: a logit shift on a starter's price (depth rank 1), fitted on the live pipeline over 2025 weeks 2-18 (research/td_depth_live.py); the backup cells flip season to season and are not used.
role_note: A projection times x^g, x = the role step's resolved / raw snap share (scripts/picks.js 'Role, sitewide'), on top of the square root it already applies to the last-3 role features: the live pipeline under-corrected both ways (promoted players ran 1.03-1.19x their projection, demoted 0.92-0.97x). Fitted on the 2025 replay (research/.cache/depth_replay.csv), ladder log loss on 2026 weeks 2-6 out of sample: receiving yards .6383 -> .6344, rush + rec .5983 -> .5931, receptions .6207 -> .6158, RB rushing .6093 -> .6053 (rushing flat on 2025 at 0.2, worse at 0.3). 10/27.
